glossary.definition: Núcleo administrativo nativo do ecossistema-escola que incorpora módulos e capacidades compartilhadas.
Versão implantada para testadores autorizados que ainda não foi liberada ao público definitivo.
Permissão funcional derivada no servidor a partir dos papéis institucionais existentes.
Resposta composta pelo backend para uma necessidade de tela sem tornar o navegador orquestrador do Graph.

entities.source_of_truth: BFF session cookie sealed by existing authentication foundation
existing Microsoft 365 group mapping in Entra claims

requirements.trigger: visit official origin without valid session
requirements.response: show redesigned institutional login experience and preserve /auth/login flow
require platform validation and read capabilities on the server
compose the dashboard server-side from existing platform registries
return only modules whose declared roles intersect the session roles; malformed declarations fail closed

preconditions: at least one dashboard source fails
requirements.response: preserve valid sections and expose degraded state without fabricated values
remain restricted until the exact production approval command is received and gates pass
remove non-essential ambient motion while retaining functional state feedback

constraints: Do not add a new authentication provider.
Do not add a new persistence provider.
Do not expose Graph tokens, certificates, SESSION_SECRET or SharePoint access to the browser.
Do not make production release contingent only on CI success.
Do not create duplicate implementations for existing foundation responsibilities.
